decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera closely aligned with the firm’s proven space optics business, it is likely to be judged against modest early aspirations and retained given the firm’s R&D strength, growth, and organizational slack.

A modular navigation camera line with several models signals stronger commitment and fit with the core portfolio, so under satisfactory early expectations and ample slack the firm would be unlikely to withdraw it quickly.

Although somewhat more exploratory, the sensor suite still builds on established capabilities and in a growing, research-intensive firm short-run uncertainty is more likely to prompt continued development than market exit.

The miniaturized LiDAR sensor appears less established commercially because it was only mentioned rather than fully featured, but its closeness to core capabilities and the firm’s resources still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
